text:
Ava: Quick poll — imagine the pantry is restocked forever with one snack only. What do you pick? No duplicates allowed. I'll go first: salted caramel granola bars. 🥰
Chris: Pretzels. always. crunchy salvation. :pretzel:
Priya: Dark chocolate. >70% or I'm not interested.
Diego: Fruit cups. practical but boring. Also low crumbs, 10/10 for keyboards.
Sam: Hot sauce packets. You can put them on anything. @Ava targeted choice :)
Ava: @Sam can we legally declare hot sauce a 'snack'? 😂
Priya: (polling with reactions) dark chocolate :chocolate_bar: — I vote!
Chris: Can we do 'office rotation' — weeks alternate? Kidding. :thumbsup:
Remy: Trail mix — but someone always eats all the peanuts and then we fight. true story. :sweat_smile:
lunchbot: FYI — pantry restock on Thursday. Suggestion box link: https://forms.gle/example
Ava: Ooh, vote in the thread w/ a reaction. I'll tally on Thursday morning. Winner gets a 'y' in stock every week. :tada:
Diego: Also, if it's chocolate, can we keep it in the freezer? Danger: winter coat required. :chocolate_bar:
Chris: freeze it = brilliant. meeting solved.
Priya: adding a half-joke rule: whoever brings the empty bag has to restock next time. 🧾
Sam: I'm logging everyone's choices in my head for the 'snack audit' 😂
Ava: Poll snapshot: dark chocolate 3, pretzels 1, granola 1, trail mix 1, fruit cups 1, hot sauce 1. Dark chocolate currently wins. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Remy: I'll concede if someone brings spicy dark chocolate. Compromise?
Priya: now that's an offer I can agree to.
Ava: Thanks everyone — I'll post final tally and check the suggestion form responses before restock. :white_check_mark:
